target_case.question: Is the team with the most blocked items also the team with the highest blocker rate? Explain using the underlying values.

baseline_observation.failure_signature: The answer did not complete the required comparison even though the run used additional model/tool work.

behavioral_requirements.name: tool_grounded_comparison
behavioral_requirements.requirement: The answer must be grounded in the benchmark tool evidence rather than unsupported inference.

behavioral_requirements.name: blocked_item_value_present
behavioral_requirements.requirement: The answer must identify Data as having 29 blocked items.

behavioral_requirements.name: blocker_rate_value_present
behavioral_requirements.requirement: The answer must identify Data as having a 20.9 percent blocker rate.

behavioral_requirements.name: explicit_same_team_conclusion
behavioral_requirements.requirement: The answer must explicitly conclude that the team with the most blocked items is also the team with the highest blocker rate.

behavioral_requirements.name: complete_underlying_values_explanation
behavioral_requirements.requirement: The explanation must connect both underlying values to the comparison instead of stopping after only one side of the question.

guardrails: Do not modify the deterministic scorer, seed-42 dataset, model, prompt, or ClickHouse permissions for this slice.
Do not replace deterministic scoring with an LLM judge.
Treat a negative result as valid evidence.
Do not make an ASSERT adoption claim until the slice has been executed and reviewed.
